# kaleido_platform_evm_connector_contract_invoke (Resource)

Invokes a function on a deployed smart contract through the 'contract/invoke' operation of a deployed EVM standard API on a connector service (see kaleido_platform_connector_standard_api), for one-off state-changing transactions such as initializing or registering configuration on a contract deployed with kaleido_platform_evm_connector_contract_deploy. The invocation is submitted as a workflow-engine transaction with a deterministic idempotency key, so each resource instance only ever submits one unique transaction. If the idempotency key is already in use by an existing transaction the apply fails, for the user to inspect that transaction and resolve the conflict. Any change to the invocation inputs replaces the resource, which submits a new transaction - the effect of the previous transaction remains on-chain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `abi` (String) The contract ABI as a JSON string, containing at least the function to invoke (pipes directly from the `abi` output of kaleido_platform_cms_build)
- `api` (String) Name (or ID) of the deployed EVM standard API instance on the connector (e.g. the name of a kaleido_platform_connector_standard_api resource)
- `environment` (String) Environment ID
- `key` (String) Lookup string used to resolve the signing key (e.g. a KMS key URI or address)
- `method` (String) The function to invoke - either its name, or its full signature (e.g. `transfer(address,uint256)`) to select between overloaded functions. An exact signature match takes precedence over a name match
- `service` (String) Connector service ID
- `to` (String) Address of the contract to invoke (e.g. the `contract_address` output of kaleido_platform_evm_connector_contract_deploy)

### Optional

- `gas` (String) Optional gas limit. When set, gas estimation is skipped
- `idempotency_key` (String) Idempotency key for the workflow-engine transaction. When unset, a deterministic key is derived from the invocation inputs so this resource only ever submits one unique transaction. Set explicitly to force a distinct invocation with otherwise identical inputs (e.g. to call the same function again with the same parameters).
- `ignore_destroy` (Boolean) When true, destroy leaves the workflow-engine transaction record in place (the effect of the transaction always remains on-chain)
- `nonce` (String) Optional nonce override for gap recovery
- `options_json` (String) Additional options for the invocation, as a JSON object string (EVM connector semantics)
- `params_json` (String) Function parameters as a JSON array (in input order) or object (keyed by input name) string. Tuple (struct) inputs are nested arrays or objects
- `value` (String) Optional value in wei to send with the invocation
- `wait_timeout` (String) Maximum time to wait for the invocation transaction to complete (Go duration string, default 10m)

### Read-Only

- `block_number` (String) Block number the invocation transaction was mined in, from the transaction receipt
- `id` (String) The workflow-engine transaction ID of the invocation
- `transaction_hash` (String) Hash of the invocation transaction, from the transaction receipt
